docs.summary: Brings a project saved with an older engine version up to [`CurrentVersion`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Projects.Project~CurrentVersion). Every format change is a [`MigrationStep`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Migration.MigrationStep) listed by the [`MigrationRelease`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Migration.MigrationRelease) it shipped in, and the steps run in version order, so a project from any older version walks up one step at a time.
Every release with migration steps, oldest first.
How many steps the release for this exact version has, zero when it has none.

members.name: PendingSteps
members.signature: public static List<(MigrationRelease Release, int Index)> PendingSteps(Project project)

docs.summary: The steps a project still needs, in the order they run.

Backs the project up, runs every pending step, then drops the import caches so everything reimports. The project records each step as it finishes, so a failed migration resumes from the step that failed.
Zips everything a migration can touch into the project's Backups folder and returns the zip path.
